label: lem:maturitynull
scope: Local maturity integrability is explicit; one null set for the integrated identity and the differentiated identity at interior T>t. The bridge from global joint integrability is not formalized.

label: prop:profile
scope: Jump-law equivalence and profile restrictions; conditional expectations and Laplace transforms have the hypotheses in the standalone statements.

label: thm:tilts
scope: Successive conditional Gaussian tilts. Includes the separate normalization at each step; it is not a claim of independent announcements under the original measure.

label: thm:realization
scope: Uniform finite dimension over varying finite calendars under the stated regularity assumptions. Lean necessity assumes a Brownian driver; the recurrence/rank algebra is unconditional.

label: prop:scaledconstruction
scope: Construction given an existing external-scale diffusion and the supplied calculus. Version and integrability assumptions are explicit.

label: prop:varianceexample
scope: Conditional on compatible single- and two-driver calculus, SDE, integral-comparison and exponential-martingale interfaces. Lean does not construct a nontrivial Brownian instance of those interfaces.

label: thm:approximation
scope: Exact publication constants and pointwise/uniform bounds are formalized, reusing the original forward bounds and recurrent realization. Price estimates assume the quasi-exponential shape, maturity versions, supplied calculus and Brownian driver (no witness constructed). Suprema of expectations only.

label: thm:splice
scope: Coefficient equivalence and locally integrable front-end process construction for a given block, with observability and deterministic initial values. The process stages use supplied calculus (degenerate instance); coefficients are progressive at each maturity and jointly Borel, not proved jointly progressive. No true-bond-martingale conclusion.

label: cor:diagonal
scope: Diagonalizable specialization of the effective-level covariance condition.

label: cor:svensson
scope: Pointwise drift/covariance classification, with positivity and resonance conditions. No SDE-existence assertion.

label: thm:varyingexponents
scope: Positive varying decays and uncorrelated front end only. Reduction is proved; classical exponent restrictions enter through AX-16 / Upstream.ExpPolyConsistency. Its consistency instance is vacuous with separate convention checks.

label: prop:bond
scope: Conditional on GaussLaw; Lean has no constructed nonzero-diffusion instance. The paper uses ordinary Brownian stochastic calculus.

label: prop:pricing
scope: Exact ideal futures/cash prices under GaussLaw. Known maturity-shaped extension uses ShapeGaussLaw (original Proposition 50); neither is a listed-American calibration theorem.

label: prop:finitequotes
scope: Known-initial-curve rescaling and mean bound, two strikes including zero variance, futures-assisted recovery and surface determination. Pricing/identification parts use GaussLaw; no nonzero-diffusion instance is constructed.

label: thm:rank
scope: Finite calendar rank and inversion are formalized without stochastic-calculus assumptions. Identification is for the stated ideal variance observations.

label: cor:shape
scope: Known maturity-shape rank algebra is formalized. Conditional pricing uses ShapeGaussLaw. Critical decay numerics and numerical conditioning are not formalized.

label: thm:aggregate
scope: Full pure-jump aggregation, including the reverse stopping-time inequality and zero total variance, is already formalized on the finite Gaussian model. American claims use a Borel state-payoff rule and integrable state envelope. The source header formerly understated this coverage; the completed proof was reused.

label: cor:generalaggregate
scope: Continuous-risk extension, including zero total variance, conditional on GaussLaw (no nonzero-diffusion instance constructed). European identity: nonnegative Borel payoffs; signed integrable case follows by decomposition in the paper. American equality: usual augmented natural filtration of integrated diffusion and revealed meetings, Borel state-payoff rule and integrable state envelope; not an arbitrary larger filtration.

label: prop:cumulative
scope: Sharp cumulative interval bounds in the ideal pure-jump model; the publication uses finite upper bounds.

label: thm:scales
scope: Exact deterministic cone, dual inequalities and ratio restrictions. The variance-integral representation is assumed by the Lean deterministic theorem; the stochastic derivation is a paper argument.

label: thm:svsupport
scope: Exact support conditional on the stated SDE solutions, moments and integrand admissibility, with upstream calculus/predictability interfaces. No numerical column independence of the three-factor example is asserted.

label: prop:svmap
scope: Conditional variance formula: stochastic representation, isometry, orthogonality and moment identities are explicit Lean premises.
